title: Fix Puzzle 3D Context Menu Styling
description: puzzle 3d: The context menu is not styled correctly and has bloat. e.g. remove the tick and checkmark. Just show highlight the item same as the 3d preview highlight.
summary: Removed context-menu tick/checkmark bloat. Checked rows now use the same active highlight as 3D preview / CanvasPickMenu (bg-active-base), and menu chrome reuses floating-menu surface/item styling. Extended ContextMenu vitest (5 passed).
